glyph.isekai_mahou.all_in.desc: Spends ALL your remaining mana: power ×(1 + extra mana ÷ cost), up to ×4, and +50% area on the previous glyph. Then you collapse: Magic Exhaustion, Slowness and Weakness for 6 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.colossal.desc: Area ×2.5 on the previous glyph. The whole spell gets power ×1.6, costs ×2.5 mana and takes +1 s to cast. Does not stack.
glyph.isekai_mahou.crater.desc: A gigantic explosion at the hit point: fireball, fire column, mushroom cloud, shockwave and tremor. 22 damage at the center (40% at the edge), fire and knockback. Opens a real CRATER (radius 6 without augments, growing with area and power up to 35 — the Explosion! legend with all your mana carves a valley), scorches the land around and sends a shockwave. Respects the destruction rule (/mahou destruction), cities and Trials.
glyph.isekai_mahou.arsenal_gate.desc: Opens 4 golden portals (+2 per Split) behind you for 3 s. Each fires a weapon every second at the aimed point or at enemies near it; each weapon applies the effects at 45% power and pierces 1 target. 5 s base cooldown.
glyph.isekai_mahou.conjured_weapon.desc: A weapon appears in the air and flies at the target: 7 damage, pierces 1 enemy and sticks in the ground. +1 weapon per Split. Fired by an Arsenal Gate, it strikes directly.
glyph.isekai_mahou.blade_field.desc: 3 swords (+1 per Split) sprout from the ground around the point, hurting anyone on top, then launch at enemies within 8 blocks: 4.5 damage each. Inside a Domain they sprout around every enemy.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_a.colossal_: Not enough mana for the Colossal spell (needs %s).
message.isekai_mahou.legends_a.all_in_co: All or Nothing! Power ×%s — you spent %s mana and collapsed from exhaustion.
